title: OpenAPI client
description: Inferred by @mo-transfer/tooling-openapi/plugin. Only the client path: adapter, options, layout and pipeline are read from openapi-clients.json at run time (a json input of the target), so an entry change never touches the project config.

client.description: Client path below libsDir = key in openapi-clients.json, e.g. generated/pet-client or booking/generated/booking-client.

verbose.description: Stream generator output, print pipeline stages and stacks (also: nx run … --verbose).
